title: Razorpay and WhatsApp Integration
seoTitle: Razorpay WhatsApp Integration: Payment Links and Receipts
seoDescription: Send Razorpay payment links, reminders and receipts on WhatsApp automatically. How it works, templates, pricing and collection results for Indian businesses.
summary: A Razorpay–WhatsApp integration sends payment links, reminders before and after due dates, and receipts on WhatsApp, and updates your records the moment a payment succeeds. For businesses that invoice customers regularly, it usually shortens the time to get paid.

dataPoints.label: Razorpay side
dataPoints.value: Payment Links API, payment and payment-link webhooks

dataPoints.label: WhatsApp side
dataPoints.value: Cloud API utility templates for reminders and receipts

dataPoints.label: Typical flow
dataPoints.value: Invoice issued, link sent, reminder at due date, receipt on payment

dataPoints.label: Records
dataPoints.value: Payment status written back to your billing system, CRM or Tally

body:
## Why WhatsApp for collections

Customers open WhatsApp messages far more reliably than emails, and a link that opens UPI directly removes friction.

## Design the reminders

- A polite link on invoice day.
- A reminder on the due date.
- A follow-up a few days later, then hand over to a person.
- Stop reminders instantly when the payment webhook arrives.

See [adding Razorpay payments and GST invoicing](/blog/adding-razorpay-payments-and-gst-invoicing-to-your-software).

faqs.a: Reminders about an existing transaction are generally utility templates, which Meta prices lower than marketing. Template approval decides the category.

faqs.q: Can customers pay by UPI from the link?
faqs.a: Yes, Razorpay payment links support UPI, cards, net banking and wallets, depending on your account settings.
